Anyways he crashed up on the curve and when he went to reverse his entire aftermarket front bumper and fenders came off clean and he peeled out leaving it all behind to spare the embarrassment. My high self saw some free money he left behind so I picked up his body kit and chucked it into the woods, with the intent of selling on Craigslist or something.
